name: ob1-auth
comment: The authorization server (SMD-2285). oidc-provider is pinned EXACTLY: its experimental features (CIMD, ack draft-02) take breaking changes in minor releases, and an unacknowledged one stops the server starting. A bump is a PR that runs the proof of concept against this directory's image: `bun evals/eval-auth.ts --up oidc-provider` builds it, `--verify oidc-provider` checks it (CI's auth-poc job does both). The devDependencies are the typecheck's (CI's portable-server job; the image installs --production): @types/oidc-provider moves with oidc-provider, the other three with server-portable's (check 18).
